## Checklist

- [ ] I signed off my commits (`git commit -s` / DCO)
- [ ] Conventional Commit messages (or squash title will be conventional)
- [ ] PR is small and focused on one concern
- [ ] Issue linked with `Closes #` / `Fixes #` when applicable
- [ ] CI is green (or this PR only updates non-CI paths)
- [ ] AI review bot comments addressed or replied to with rationale
- [ ] Docs/content: no invented facts; licensing rules followed (CC BY-SA–compatible copy only; NC sources link-only; no Khan Academy AI training/scraping)
- [ ] Decision log updated when this locks or supersedes a decision
